04   /   GOOD TO KNOW

A few things
you might ask.

Getting to know us?
Let’s start here.

What’s in the collection?+

Desi ghee in 250 g, 500 g, and 1 kg jars; dahi in 500 g and 1 kg sizes; and a Breakfast Duo with 500 g ghee and 1 kg dahi. Packaging shown in the pictures is a concept for the launch.

How do I ask for prices or place an order?+

Choose your products and sizes, add them to your enquiry list, and email us at enquiries@example.com. We’ll share prices and confirm availability, payment, and delivery before accepting an order.

Where will you deliver?+

We’re planning to launch in Lahore. Delivery areas, charges, and times will be announced when ordering opens. Any final delivery details will be confirmed before an order is accepted.

How should I store my products?+

Keep dahi refrigerated. Follow the storage, handling, and use-by instructions on each final product label. Use a clean, dry spoon for ghee and close its lid after use.

Do these products contain milk?+

Ghee and dahi are dairy products. Check the final ingredient and allergen labels before buying, particularly if you have a milk allergy or other dietary requirements.

Your enquiry list is saved in this browser. Any details you enter stay on your device until you choose to send them by email. You can download your enquiry or clear the saved list at any time.
